text:
harper: FYI planning a staggered catalog flip for orion-13b-v1-quant during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. want quick alignment on traffic-slicing, emergency snapshot pin, and fallback ordering.

deploy-bot: scheduled by @harper for 3666670800. rollout plan: slice traffic 2%->10%->40% over 45m. auto-rollback thresholds: error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 25% over baseline.

noah: runtime suggests traffic-slices + sticky-sessions for the canary so we don't double-hit cold starts. also recommend snapshot-pin that points back to orion-13b:20260310 for 90m in case of manual revert.

jess: agree on sticky sessions. propose fallback_order:
```yaml
fallbacks:
  - orion-13b-v1-quant
  - orion-13b-v1
  - orion-13b
promotion_hold_minutes: 10
fallback_debounce_minutes: 12
```
prevents rapid flip-flop and gives time to triage.

runtime-bot: noted. adding sticky_sessions=true for canary slice. will not prime EU until infra-sre okays.

infra-sre: we'll give EU priming a manual_go after NA 10% tranche. if host_mem_avg > 68% or evictions spike we'll request immediate drain.

harper: add emergency snapshot pin command in the runbook: `catalog pin --model orion-13b --snapshot 20260310 --ttl 90m` so anyone can revert quickly. put that in release notes.

noah: small release config to paste into deploy job:
```json
{"model":"orion-13b-v1-quant","slices":[2,10,40],"sticky_sessions":true,"pin_snapshot":"20260310","pin_ttl_minutes":90,"eu_priming":"manual_go","fallback_debounce_minutes":12}
```

jess: i'll update dashboards to watch token_latency_by_slice, fallback_count, host_mem_avg, and canary_error_rate. ETA 30m.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed. canary containers healthy. starting at scheduled epoch unless aborted.

harper: final checklist: (1) deploy-bot schedule locked, (2) sticky sessions enabled, (3) EU priming = manual_go, (4) fallback ladder + debounce in place, (5) emergency snapshot pin ready, (6) dashboards wired. object?

infra-sre: no objections. oncall watching and will post go/no-go after 10% tranche.

harper: launching at 3666670800. ping here immediately to request rollback or pin. :rocket:
